title: Better Files mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from Better Files's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod. "none": only where a layout or another mod puts it.

focusable.description: Lets pane.go give a shown copy the keyboard.

settings.description: Your changes. A setting left out uses its default.

tree.title: Tree refresh
tree.description: How often the tree rereads, on top of watching the folder. Never closer than 1 second.

file.title: File refresh
file.description: How often an open file is checked for changes. Never closer than 500ms.

editors.title: More editors
editors.description: macOS app IDs to add to Open in, such as dev.zed.Zed. Shown only if installed.

gutter.title: Changed lines
gutter.description: Tint changed lines. Off uses Herdr's own editor instead: fuller highlighting, selection and folding, but no line colours.

markdown.title: Markdown opens as
markdown.description: How a Markdown file first shows: Preview renders it, Code shows its text with changed lines. Each tab remembers the last choice from the toggle.
